style.tone: cozy, festive Chinese New Year mood
style.props: cartoon cat-paw steaming bowl, bamboo steamer
style.food: black sesame rice cake, smooth texture

global_constraints: only child hands in final shot
winter sleeve with Spring Festival atmosphere
consistent bowl position center-frame for shots 1-3

shots.prompt: A bright and clean warm kitchen countertop. Ultra close-up of a cute cartoon cat-paw steaming bowl fixed in center frame. Thick black sesame slurry, silky and glossy, pours into the bowl. Gentle natural window light, cinematic food macro, realistic texture, cozy Chinese New Year ambiance in background decorations. Keep bowl position stable.

Same kitchen and same cat-paw bowl in exactly the same position. Creamy white rice slurry pours into the bowl, smooth and silky, layering with black sesame base. Slight push-in compared to previous shot. Food commercial quality, macro realism.

Same bowl and same position, even closer. One to two clear fresh pear juice droplets fall into the cat-paw bowl and ripple softly. Progressive push-in, macro lens look, clean highlights, warm cozy kitchen background bokeh.
A wooden bamboo steamer lid is lifted, steam blooms and clears, revealing a cute cat-paw shaped black sesame rice cake inside. Warm, appetizing, bright kitchen lighting, natural steam motion.
Several black sesame rice cakes tumble from off-screen into a clean rustic bamboo steamer basket, then bounce twice to show chewy springy texture (Q弹). Food ad style, crisp details, soft warm light.

shots.camera: close-up, eye-level to slight low angle
shots.prompt: Only a 5-year-old child's small hands (no face, no body) wearing winter festive sleeves with Chinese New Year style raise one black sesame cat-paw rice cake and gently twist it. Bright clean warm kitchen backdrop. Keep child identity unrecognizable.

negative_prompt: human face, portrait, text, watermark, logo, extra fingers, malformed hands, dark dirty kitchen, horror, low quality
